name: Multi-Sensor Advanced Climatology of Liquid Water Path (MAC-LWP)
model_or_instrument: Passive microwave radiometers (7 satellite sources) and MODIS
access: MAC‐LWP is available through the Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC, current hosting: http://disc.sci.gsfc.nasa.gov)

scales.note: MAC-LWP monthly mean data constructed at 0.25 degrees and aggregated to 1 degree over the 2000–2016 period.
